title: Kafdrop console is reachable without authentication
description: The Kafdrop console is served without authentication. Kafdrop lists every topic, shows message payloads and can create or delete topics on the cluster it is pointed at.
remediation: Put Kafdrop behind an authenticating proxy or remove it; it has no built-in access control.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Kafdrop console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Kafdrop</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
